notes.title: 1.06 Published
notes.content:
1.06 has been published.

Changelog:

Improved shadow resolution on launch and landings
Fixed a few UI bugs showing the wrong button prompt
Fixed some VO in orbital missions
Visual improvements on launch and fixed orbit direction in closing shot.

Happy flying!

notes.title: 1.04 Published
notes.content:
1.04 has been released! We've got visual tweaks and improvements across the board.

[list]
[*] Improved Shadow Distance in Landings
[*] New end cutscene in orbital missions
[*] Deployment arm now moves more realistically
[*] UI tweaks
[*] Fixed spellings & UI bugs
[/list]

notes.title: 1.03 Published
notes.content:
1.03 is now live! 

Fixes:
Fixed controllers not showing in main menu unless active and tracking before app startup
Fixed Incorrect icons on some index / vive button prompts
Fixed control binding for ingame menu on index
Fixed wingtip camera clipping in landings
Fixed haptics continuing shortly after takeoff

Tweaks
Landing gear can now be deployed in airspeeds above 350 in landings
Increased shadow distance
